I started playing this game during a period when I was struggling to enjoy video games. Oblivion Override made me enjoy them again.

Gameplay 10/10 Story 3/10 Gameplay was fantastic. Multiple weapons to choose from, multiple "characters" to play as. All with unique gameplay which is pretty awesome. Gameplay is very reactive and I don't really have any complaints with it. It's a fast paced beat-em-up roguelike and something I've absolutely been wanting. I do have a few complaints though. 1. Story. I wasn't really expecting a super linear story, but getting any story out of this game is harder to find than dark souls. I run a mission, I come back, and no one wants to talk to me, there's no new content, I've already beaten all of the alert levels and the old man has spoken to me 2 or 3 times so far. I don't know if there's more if I continue playing, but I've had a pretty long drought of nothing new happening story-wise, so that's kind of a problem. 2. Level design is mostly ok at first. But playing the same 3 levels over and over does get a little stale. I wish there were other biomes you could go to instead of the 2nd biome or 3rd biome. The 4th biome really feels like they cut corners. I don't mind the arena-like feel to it, but it doesn't feel like they wanted to do something different. It just feels like they were rushing to finish development. 3. You finish your upgrades with perfect nanites pretty fast. Then you just keep collecting them forever and there's no longer any use for them. It'd be nice if it let you buy an item ahead of time, either let you spend it for an rng item then double the price with each purchase, or let you spend more of it to choose a specific item you want. Imo, rng would be better. 4. I also think the upgrades end too early for the perfect nanites. Should let us continue upgrading our characters stats a bit longer, but they all seem to cap pretty fast. 5. No multiplayer. Not that this is a requirement by any means, but it is something I'd desire from a game like this. I don't really count this as a negative, just something I'd like.

This game was a part of Humble's Mecha Bundle April 2026 This is a great game. Within 2 days I've amassed over 10 hour in the game. It's been a while since I've found a roguelite in a 2D platformer format that had me in such a chokehold. Last time was Dead Cells and BlazBlue Entropy Effect? Oblivion Override plays very very similar to Dead Cells, where it draws obvious inspiration from. Roguevania style biomes with the Dead Cells-esque teleporters for ease of backtracking. It does do some things that differentiate itself though. It features a more classic roguelite progression system where you can upgrade max HP, damage, additional upgrade slots, rerolls, death defiance, all that jazz. New playable characters are unlocked as you progress through the game. Run augmentations called services are unlocked and can be purchased with a type of meta progression currency. Within a run, upgrades fall into several different categories and each upgrade selected from one category will also contribute to the level of that category alongside the upgrade itself, incentivizing specializations. Weapons are randomized at the beginning of every run. You can find weapon drops within the biomes and in shops. You'll eventually unlock a way to disassemble unwanted weapons similar to Dead Cells in order to upgrade the weapon that you're currently using. Health potions and trinkets drop liberally. Lots of metaprogression unlocks... even 10 hours in, I'm still unlocking new characters, weapons, services, new bosses. On the topic of bosses.... PEAK. Very fair and telegraphed. You'll be able to defeat many of them on your first attempt at the base difficulty. Increasing the difficulty will give them more HP, do more damage, and even give them an evolved form with augmented movesets at higher difficulties. They're generally easier than the bosses in Dead Cells because of the fair telegraphs. But that doesn't make them any less fun. I actually prefer the bosses in this game. Would absolutely recommend this game, especially if you want to fill the hole left by Dead Cells. Or even to metroidvania players looking for a shorter form "run based" platformer to play. You'll be right at home.

An absolutely excellent title that belongs in the library of every fan of action games. Everything from the smooth wall running and omnidirectional dashing to the chunky power hits and swift jabs feels great to play. During the run you'll choose from a semi-random assortment of passive abilities to augment your mech, with more advanced abilities depending on which combinations you've leveled up. Each mech has their own passive and active abilities, as does each weapon. Getting into the flow of combat feels so good that when a run is over, you feel yourself being pulled back to that teleporter once again for just one more go because you just know you'll do even better this time. Adjustable difficulty, secrets, and plenty of enemy variety along with a great art style make each attempt at the fortress a great time. This game is absolutely worth a buy at full price, and I look forward to whatever Humble Mill has in store for us next.

制作组就没想过明明是一款素质还不错的游戏，为什么卖的这么差吗？ 很简单，因为这游戏玩着“爽不起来”，我可以忍受你前期开荒受苦，我可以忍受花费大量时间去刷局外成长，但麻烦你让我在付出这些精力时间之后可以“爽起来”，你可以有适合高手发挥的build，但你不能只有适合高手发挥的build。举个例子，卖的很好的暖雪，在天赋树点满之前大多时候也爽不起来，但是人家花费一定时间完成开荒之后把局外成长点满，哪怕是手残也可以使用一些比较无脑的套路很“爽”的通关游戏，但同时高手也能使用神行等操作上限比较高的build挑战自己。你这游戏可以嘛？我手残，然后我花大量时间点满了天赋树和80%以上的装甲进化，但我大多时候玩着还是很憋屈。之前的ea版本高警戒（7/8）之下我只有使用维克+斧，用攒大招进战斗然后拿到吸血核心的情况下才能比较顺利通关警戒8，结果嚯嚯正式版一看，你把唯一能爽的维克给砍了（但是更新后我依然是使用维克+斧+吸血通关了警戒8），现状是菜鸟玩家在高警戒下大多数机甲和武器都玩不转…… 看看现在的警戒8，我更新后用新机甲拿着你们送的扳手武器进第一张图打第一波战斗，打个霸体大怪砍了几十刀才砍死真把我乐死了，究竟是什么原因非得让你们坚持把数值做的这么保守呢？ 保持硬核可能会让你在高手玩家圈子里保持高口碑，但你要清楚这些受众是小众，他们的数量撑不起游戏的销量，大部分游戏玩家是普通玩家甚至是菜鸡玩家，给他们也能玩的“爽”的可能才能给带给你销量

18小时通关警戒线5，武器全解锁，这游戏目前就系统来看完成度还是比较高的，游戏方式是类死亡细胞，技能成长则缝合了哈迪斯，手感算是同类游戏中比较好的，但考虑了许久，暂时还是给予不推荐评价。0.6版本内容量偏少，大概比细胞老版本打完大眼怪多一点吧，地图和boss都较少，游戏应该改进的地方也不少： 1.核心也就是遗物存在感太弱了，而且很多都是数值上的强化，缺少一些独特性。 2.能消费的地方比较少，除了刷武器外就只有店老板了，碰上献血店的几率几乎可以忽略不计，店老板会打后基本都是零元购的，所以S币的价值存在感也比较薄弱，导致一些相关的技能和遗物很鸡肋。 3.后期特别是高难度下，画面非常乱，很多投射物都不明显，包括碎片什么的经常和敌人混在一起，更何况高难度下堆怪严重，突出一个群魔乱舞。 4.敌人滥用霸体导致不平衡，很多技能和武器都形同虚设，不能破霸体的，没有无敌时间的，动作慢的，基本都被淘汰了，能打的只有那几种，主要突出一个生存率和杀敌效率，像是自动攻击的电，残影攻击，走路回盾，被打中有霸体减伤这几个明显比其他什么强多了，警戒5很多武器和技能都没法用，说白了就是根本活不过第一关，此外某些敌人打着打着突然来一招霸体攻击真的非常恶心，建议删了，打起来非常不爽。 5.高难度≠数值提高，我觉得高难度纯粹只是给敌人加攻加血自己减少回复一点设计都没有，说难听点纯粹提升一些数值小学生都会做，500血不小心连续中两招就只剩三分之一了，明明高难度下有新型敌人就是不错的设计，而boss反而就没有新招或新形态，搞得boss高难度反而没有加强一样。 6.主角几乎没有无敌时间和霸体时间，这个玩着很难受，经常被连招打得动惮不得，应该增加可以立回的基础技能或场外升级。 7.取消dna技能槽上限，肉鸽游戏玩的就是各种不同技能组合产生的化学反应，最有意思的是一局里打出能各种秒杀boss或无敌的效果，而目前因为流程不够长外加技能槽限制可以组合成完整套路的也就只有寥寥几种，玩久了基本都只点那几个强的技能，且由于技能槽有限后续都要把弱的删了，大大制约了可玩性，此外目前每种大类下的技能太少了，同一系的技能来来回回就那几种，玩不出花来。
不是，你要弄高难度可以弄，但是你技能能不能不要这么炫啊，一堆技能贼鸡儿亮，我人都不知道在哪里了，等我找到人都被打成狗了，BOSS特效角色技能，武器技能，一套下来什么都看不见了，还隔着走位呢

如果更新前是8/10的话，那么更新后我只能给6/10了，看在EA时期游戏体验的份上还是给个好评吧。第四章内容略显空洞且新出的角色多少有点意义不明（会受到飞行道具伤害的时停大招+机甲技能的混乱效果几乎没用），平衡性做得过分保守导致玩家根本爽不起来，高难度下非常坐牢，体验极差。如果这些平衡性是给所谓的喜欢挑战自己的“高玩”做的话，那我也无话可说了，毕竟不是所有人都有大把时间在一个冷门的单机游戏里提升自己的水平。 调整游戏难度和做平衡时不要过分听信群友的话，因为绝大多数玩家根本就没在群里，也不会发表自己的意见，除非游戏的某次更新真的很烂，就比如这次。被一些不懂装懂的傻缺带偏节奏对本就不火的游戏而言是雪上加霜的，希望开发者能明白这一点。 --------------------------- 仔细想了下，还是改成差评吧，好让开发者能重视更多诸如此类的批评意见。

There isn't anything that's necessarily outwardly WRONG with this game, but there is basically nothing original here. The movement and overall gameplay feels clunky and generally not very good, the story is terrible and the game's bonuses often aren't strong enough to meaningfully impact your run. The area for the first boss is so directly inspired by the ramparts from Dead Cells that it's unignorable; I'm talking high up, yellow background, flags everywhere, the whole 9 yards. This game is a bold 4/10, it's not the worst thing in the world but there are basically no upsides compared to any other game in the genre. Just save yourself the trouble and play Dead Cells.

I want to start with: I enjoyed this game - or at least most of it - on the whole. I appreciated what the developers did, and certain things were a lot of fun the first time. That said, a number of things frustrated me in less of a "that game was hard" way and more of a "this is a fixable problem" way or a "I wish I could have a few words with the developer and offer to proofread and copy-edit their English localization" way. Here are a few of the issues I'd love to see fixed, most of which would have been relatively easy to address: 1. The grammar and even the spelling are incomprehensibly poor- even things like the names of items or skills that are shown in different contexts have _different_ misspellings, and nearly every piece of dialogue, description, narration, or tutorial text is not only difficult to understand, but often seems to contradict itself 2. Within descriptions of skills, buffs, stats, and so forth, different terminology is often used for the same thing, while other very key mechanics may use the same term (such as the word "pulse") even though an effect only applies in one narrower context. There is no way to deduce the actual result of certain skills from their descriptions, and the game doesn't allow you to pause during combat rooms if you happen to enter one in the all-too-common case where you misunderstand the text. 3. The game frequently presents you with choices that are costly to reverse without showing you what the choice means - and this isn't a narrative choice, but sort of an assumption that you, like the developers, somehow already know the mechanics. Things like presenting you with the option to spend money - of which there are at least five kinds - on "auscultation," or investing a different set of the resources accumulated between runs in new player characters, without telling you those resources are what you're going to spend or how much. 4. The game's own sense of humor is a very stilted fit for its aesthetic: certain items, characters, or skills - rather than being a subtle nod to other games - will straight-up use the exact names of things the developers saw in those other games. One character has a "shoryuken." A weapon you can unlock that gets a bonus for backstabs in a similar way to the dagger in Dead Cells uses a nearly-identical animation. 5. Bizarrely, the full randomization of level layouts doesn't occur until NG+2, and until then much of the world is repetitive - and because there are no branching paths between levels, you're always playing the same three levels in the same order, with only subtle differences of layout each time. By the time NG+2 rolls around, there's a good chance you've unlocked most of the content already, which doesn't leave you a ton of incentive to keep playing. 6. Much of the benefit you accrue from using mechanics the game never explains is critical to surviving a run, especially once NG+1 starts - but the level of luck required versus skill or strategy is quite high, and if you discover you can influence the randomness (e.g., by locking some of the random options out, which is the main way you do that), you end up discovering that there are a couple "golden paths" that reduce the difficulty, but other things rarely contribute, and do so with very low percentage bonuses. A lot of the above feedback - which, yes, is a lot of words - comes down to the copy-editing the English localization very badly needs. To be sure, there are also some mechanics that might be overwrought and benefit from simplifying rather than adding more content that doesn't fit the other pieces, but even communicating more clearly how they work or what they do, on top of drastically revising the dialogue and dealing with basic UI issues like text overflowing buttons, would go a long way.

Overall, very solid game. if you are here for a tighter dead cells with an omni directional dash and cool, albeit shallow character designs, this is the game for you. Also, digital, holographic mane. really damn cool idea. If you are here for the theme and subject, i must sorely disappoint you. i love mechs and hearing about a mech game with rouge elements really made me excited for a moment, Until you realize that the characters are just glorified archetypes you've seen everywhere else, with a mecha skin stitched on top. We have punching guy, with his ult just being an extended version of his normal ability , literal throwing knives?? guy, a digital spirit summoner, a thunder elemental and a character which has the time stop item you know of in other games as their ultimate. 警戒8通了好多遍，也觉得是时候放下这个游戏了。但翻了一圈评测，有不少人说这个游戏难度过高，很难有满足感。这里我要澄清一下，即便你玩到了警戒8，同样会有基于平衡性上的大问题。 先说结论：这是一个优缺点都很明显的游戏。如果你底子不好，前期会比较难熬，但凭这个游戏的优秀手感，或许可以支撑你玩下去。就我个人而言，这份新鲜感大概可以支撑15-20小时。警戒5算是一个分水岭，因为此时玩家对于自己喜欢的玩法和怪物的应对也差不多知道个大概了，而游戏本身也没有提供更多的一次性内容可供消费。这个时候就可以停下来思考，这个游戏的手感和一系列设计是否会让你想要反复游玩并挑战更高难度。 因为后期，才是这个游戏的问题集中点。这一点很好理解，不仅仅是这个游戏，很多看起来没有什么大问题的游戏在高难度下都容易凸显出矛盾点。因为高难度意味着容错率的减少，这一点会逼迫玩家去选择最优选，在被迫选择最优选的路上就会不得不意识到设计师给出的很多其它选择，相比最优选带来的优势完全是天上地下。这个问题在这个游戏中同样如此。 举个例子。这个游戏中有进化可以提供“技能伤害”，但并不是所有技能都在此列，其中就包括不少角色的个人技能。比如，aya的执行之刃，它就是那个固定50点伤害，又比如雷霆的电荷风暴，它也是固定的200点伤害。放在低难度下其实没有什么大问题，因为大家整体的数值都偏小，可在高难度下就成了问题。这点伤害根本起不到“凸显角色价值”的作用。 所以，是什么理由，让设计师觉得这些技能的伤害有必要维持在初始值呢？是因为它们都属于机甲技能吗？那问题来了，为什么维克的英灵斩和康特的升龙拳又能吃到技能加成呢？ 这种感觉就像是什么呢？魔兽争霸里的角色和技能被原封不动搬进了某个rpg地图里，随着个人属性的增长，固定伤害性技能的价值越来越低，于是喜欢打架的玩家都跑去选剑圣和恶魔猎手这种靠平A就能杀出一条血路的角色了。 我不想说什么法师狗都不玩这种暴论，因为它带来不了额外的价值。我更疑惑的是，为什么没有人提出这个问题？ 这个游戏里的平A，能吃到最高10级的武器等级的加成；能吃到战意最高400%的高额加成；能吃到全息影像最高240%的高额加成；能吃到倚财仗势配合精密切割在最后一关能达到90%左右的高额加成；能吃到暴怒最高45%的暴击率加成；能吃到死斗最高160%的高额加成等等等等。 更不要说这还没算芯片和装备加成，比如说教学刑具的粉笔，固定技能点名再吃15%的增伤，词条如果有点名增伤，再多30%。最后造就的巨大优势完全可以无视角色特色，大杀特杀。 我拿着练习用刀用拔刀斩艰难玩到第四大关，叠70+层，一刀下去也就1400-1700，暴击能到4600左右。可同一时期我用平A流单次攻击轻松1200-1600，分身2000以上是常态，用的也是教学刑具这种快攻速武器，打boss还没进二阶段就打了70%血量。反观技能得等CD，我还得艰难跟boss周旋。就很想问自己，去体验所谓的“武器特色”和“角色特色”干什么呢？ 其中固然有平A相关的加成实在是很多的问题，但更重要的是，其它类型的伤害能够给予相关加成的内容相比之下实在是太少。更不用说还有“固定伤害”在。我都不知道警戒8难度下那50一跳的数字和200一跳的数字看着是有多好笑。 个人猜测，设计师大概是想凸显游戏本身的操作性，于是有意将数值方面的变动压低。但我想说的是，高难度下，这他喵的就不是一个强调“手感”的游戏，是基于数值的RPG！你有技术，没有数值依旧是白搭。比起手感，更重要的是数字。 我还是那句话。低难度下按照对战图的标准来做，强调手感和操作，没有问题。不过，高难度下的核心终究是RPG，不是手感。好的手感固然能让人在重复的内容中反复游玩，但在高难度下，我更想看到一张图，一张用夸张的数字凸显我在高难度下用多好的状态和运气拿到了多好的数据的展示图。 至少，让我不用每次都去计算，我自己到底有多少生命恢复加成，可不可以在预留打boss血量的基础上把抽血罐搞爆吧？ 哦对，还有那个见鬼的能源站。从头至尾都是50点生命上限和50%生命恢复的选择，每次只要不和诊所同时出现就让我哭笑不得。都警戒8了，好歹慷慨点吧。50点或者10%自动选最高没那么难给吧？

你游目前有很多严重问题，我挑几个关键的讲： 1、出招太硬。普通攻击连招期间按不出闪避，也不能自由转向，导致玩家在面对霸体敌人、集群敌人时难以处理突发状况。 2、招架困难。敌人的抬手动作时间太长（尤其是第一关的扳手小兵，抬手动作长的一批），虽然方便玩家做好冲刺准备，但也掐灭了玩家靠招架类技能通关的可能，反而是拿着“迅捷之刃”搁那里等小兵抬手打我等半天却格挡失败挨了一刀的我更像个憨批，直接拿刀砍不好吗？建议制作组学习《死亡细胞》，小兵做出抬手的时候按下招架动作刚好，或者给敌人配上攻击光效。 3、受击硬直、击飞对玩家干扰严重且无法处理。但凡是受击，无论是15点伤害还是75点伤害都会触发受击卡顿，割裂战斗体验。一旦挨到BOSS一击很容易被控到死。以“地下搏击场”的BOSS为例，该BOSS可以冲拳和下砸，玩家接下难以闪避的冲拳后便会被击飞，此时会有被下砸或者龙卷风控住的可能。建议安排“受身”功能避免受击大硬直。 4、二技能做招期间伤害吃满。像“蔚蓝长枪”、“军刺”这类二技能出招时间长的武器在做招期间，角色没有无敌也无法闪避，很容易伤害吃满。我现在卡在了警戒等级Ⅲ，伤害多吃一点都很要命。 5、二技能存在感稀薄。有CD的常用技能可能适合MOBA类多人竞技游戏，但并不适合动作类单机游戏，你难道很享受“热战中没时间看左下角技能UI就冲进怪堆，结果二技能按了半天发现CD没好打不出来”的体验吗？所以玩家很容易忘记二技能的存在。建议学一学手游《绝区零》的安排，二技能没充能时也可以使用，但会以较低输出的形态打出。这样还可以进一步设计普攻、二技能交替打出的搓招技能。

this review was made august 4th of 2023 very early in the games early access, so if you are reading this negative review later, ignore this. that saying the game has a LOT of potential and might remove this review when i happen to buy it again when its more polished, the combat flow is good, and the weapons are fun. but now on to the negative. the animation is lackluster, it is obviously using the bone pose feature from the 2d animated software and you can clearly see the squashing and stretching on the textures the animations for enemies also look robotic. something like an in battle stance and pumped up might help when alerted. this may seem like a personal nitpick(which it kinda is) but i grew up obsessed with 2d animation and watched flash animations as a kid. ive learned a lot about how animation works due to my hyperfixation and love animations, but i felt very dissapointed when i saw this beautiful enviroment and to see it used cheap animation techniques that were used with liscensed flash cartoons like johnny test, and you do NOT wanna be compared to that. the combat is fun but the loop can be repetitive. its just mash the attack button then the special, and dash all over the place, the enemies to me don't give off the challenge and patterns or tells for an attack a game like this such as dead cells has(another thing that has to do with animation) there are too many currencies to keep track of, i dont know what they all do, and the other mechanics are to overly complicated and hard to keep track it all. also theres a racist asian characature as a character in the story that i'm not a big fan of. that being said, i like the product thats there so far, but i dont find a need to keep it. its not THERE for me you know?. as an additional note to the developer(s) keep up the good work, i can tell this will be a great game.
